youtube.title: What If Your IQ Doubled Every Day?
youtube.intro: One morning you wake up twice as smart. The next morning, twice as smart again. Every day at 7 AM your IQ doubles: math homework, Japanese, a million-dollar math problem. But your brain is the hungriest organ you own, and it is getting hotter every day.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Keep the brain, or keep your family? 👇 What would you have done on that last night?

And why is it happening to Ellie now? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The science checks out: an IQ of 200 should turn up about once in 76 billion people, your brain is 2% of your weight but burns about 20% of your energy, and Japanese takes about 2,200 hours of class. Sources are in the description.
